messages.subject: subjunc 1.5.0-p2 error
parts:
Hi:
  
We encountered an error in subjunc 1.5.0-p2 when using the --allJunctions option (see below for command line and screen output).  The error doesn't occur without the --allJunctions option.  We can provide the FASTQ and reference files for this sample offline if desired.

Thanks,

Dan

Command line:

(Compiled and running on Red Hat 6.7)

'./subread-1.5.0-p2-source/bin/subjunc' '-u' '-i' 'reference/human_g1k_v37' '-r' 'test_fastq/test_R1.fastq.gz' \

'-R' 'test_fastq/test_R2.fastq.gz' '--gzFASTQinput' '-o' 'test_out/test.bam' \

'-I' '5' '-T' '7' '-d' '50' '-D' '600' '-S' 'fr' '--allJunctions'
